single-source.why: The component takes window.app.todos as a prop, subscribes with todos.on(EVENTS, forceRender), and reads and writes through the models (t.get, t.save, t.destroy) without copying todos into React state.

event-cleanup.why: The useEffect cleanup calls todos.off(EVENTS, forceRender) on unmount.

patch-save.why: onChange calls t.save({ done: e.target.checked }, { patch: true }), the same as the original.

order.why: It renders with todos.map(...) over the collection, which is already sorted by the 'order' comparator, and re-renders on the 'sort' event.

escape.why: Titles render as {t.get('title')} JSX text with no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, and the summary notes React escapes them.

no-silent-changes.why: The diff adds no rollback or optimistic-UI logic, and the summary flags the real caveats: nothing was compiled or run, the old file is still present, and a bundler is needed.
